scope: All fourteen Mechs and culturebotai-claw were pinned at their public main revisions for the October 18, 2026 refresh. The common pin-time bound is 2026-10-19T03:30:47.183206+00:00. Census occurrences, shared-term overlap assets, complete heatmap record lists and record statistics use those same immutable revisions. AIMech joins with imported AIO classes and maintained native concepts counted separately in its card description. AIO and arXiv are newly recognized external namespaces and are rescanned consistently across every Mech and the unchanged pinned kg-microbe release. The graph shared-term vocabulary rules are unchanged. Card figures and secondary claims were rechecked against pinned source files and live sites; repository and published-browser totals retain their stated distinctions. Merged-PR counts are all-time totals queried during this refresh for fourteen Mechs, CLAW and this website. Website features were reassessed on live sites independently of source pins, using headless Chrome and successful deployment statuses. CMMMech and AIMech began publishing their websites on October 12, 2026, and their website features were judged in site-only rechecks. The separately versioned kg-microbe core release comparison is recorded in kg_microbe_census.json and is excluded from Mech record totals and shared-term graph indexes.

repositories.notes: The canonical inventory contains 1,259 concept records: 442 generated AIConcept records under data/aio and 817 maintained CuratedAIConcept records under data/curated. Imported concepts retain AIO release 2026-07-22 and its source attribution; maintained concepts carry AIMech IDs, claim-specific evidence and explicit AIO mappings or documented no-match assessments. The two schemas use NOT_REVIEWED and DRAFT respectively, with no REVIEWED-bearing status slot; scientific reviews are separate artifacts, so the common review statistic is null. Counts and source links use the complete pinned Git inventory, excluding source snapshots, reviews and history sidecars. AIMech has native LinkML schemas, validation and history support; its website first deployed on October 12, 2026. Project code is BSD-3-Clause; AIO data and derived concepts retain CC BY 4.0. Ontology membership does not demonstrate model performance, safety or mechanism. LICENSE-DATA explicitly grants CC BY 4.0 for AIO source data and derived data/aio records; that notice does not specify a data-license grant for the maintained data/curated concepts. The live data inventory is byte-identical to data inventory at the pin.

2,939 data/antibiotics records at the pin, equal to the published stat tile: 2,669 ontology-grounded and 270 minted. The README and corpus contain 80 REVIEWED, 30 PROPOSED and 2,829 SEEDED records, 454 with a mode of action and 282 with a molecular target. The live index.html is byte-identical to pages/index.html at the pin.

909 data/structures records at the pin, equal to the stat tile: 13 categories, 760 GO-grounded, 149 minted and 214 membrane organelles. All 909 are PROPOSED. The generated README and corpus contain 745 records with components and 851 with causal graphs (882 individual graphs and 3,776 evidence-backed edges); 74 records have imaging data. The live index.html is byte-identical to pages/index.html at the pin.

602 canonical data/records material records: 354 mineral species, 111 secondary resources, 66 elements, 33 commodities, 31 primary resources and seven mineral groups. The 66 element records carry ChEBI identities; 281 records carry NCBITaxon organism identifiers. 481 records describe 589 mechanisms with cited evidence, assay context and limitations; 121 remain identity and characterization records without assigned microbial mechanisms or inherited criticality. Scientific review artifacts and append-only curation history are committed. The LinkML CriticalMineralRecord schema and native strict validator exist, but there is no top-level REVIEWED-bearing status slot, so review-status statistics remain null. Counts come from the complete Git tree inventory of data/records YAML files, excluding tests and review artifacts. Record links point to pinned repository files; its website first deployed on October 12, 2026. The pin contains CC BY 4.0 project-data and BSD-3-Clause code licenses, retaining upstream terms. The live records inventory is byte-identical to data/records inventory at the pin.

The published landing tile counts 458 kb/communities records. Four additional data/isolates records make the common census and repository-statistics total 462. The landing category tile agrees with the schema enum and browser facet: 16 categories, including PHAGE_PREDATION. Embedding maps are separate derived artifacts and currently show 322 PaCMAP and 292 graph-layout communities. The live index.html is byte-identical to docs/index.html at the pin.

The 64a625a canonical snapshot declares fourteen members, twenty-four governed artifacts and twenty-seven capabilities per member. AIMech is newly declared, and the record-review contract is enabled throughout the fleet. Capability tooltips preserve the canonical status, settings and reasons, including native validation or history that does not yet meet a shared adapter contract. Contract adoption and separate scientific review artifacts do not imply that a record has a REVIEWED-bearing status or that every workflow runs unattended.

The committed README and app/index.html both state 15,910 normalized and 6,320 merged records, matching the corpus directories at the pin. The card checker retains the README corpus snapshot as its count source. docs/DATA_LAYERS.md documents GitHub Actions publishing for the generated browser assets and checks both README and landing-page counts against the corpus. Five category directories are populated. MediaIngredientMech links occur in 5,700 merged recipes and 70,461 of 100,448 ingredient rows (70.1%). Browser evidence and CommunityMech provenance links have improved without changing these corpus totals. The live README.md is byte-identical to README.md at the pin.

8,296 seed families in data/worklists/interpro-pfam-duf-2026-10-10.json, validated against its frozen manifest: 6,127 UNKNOWN_CANDIDATE, 373 KNOWN_HISTORICAL_DUF and 1,796 EX_DUF. EX_DUF records Pfam naming history, not validated function. Each JSON row is one measured family; the TSV is a redundant serialization. Counts, heatmap occurrences and shared-term links measure this seed worklist. Native FamilyRecords have a LinkML schema and public family pages with evidence, curation history and specific cross-Mech leads; 8,161 are SEEDED and 135 are IN_PROGRESS, and all 8,296 remain UNSCORED. All 8,296 measured Pfam IDs have native page routes. The measured seed worklist has no review-status field, so the statistics do not infer zero reviewed from the separate native schema. The current cross-Mech snapshot retains 16,298 evidence-lead rows from seven siblings at original acquisition pins, derived offline to the October 10 worklist. The original scan targeted 6,532 families; 1,764 additions remain marked unscanned, even where historical names resolve to current families. These leads do not validate a family's function. The live interpro-pfam-duf-2026-10-10.json is byte-identical to data/worklists/interpro-pfam-duf-2026-10-10.json at the pin.

3,209 data/habitats records at the pin, equal to the stat tiles: 735 REVIEWED, 2,474 SEEDED and 2,151 ontology-grounded by the site’s grounding-status measure. REVIEWED is a recorded status, not proof of human review. The README and corpus contain 175 records attested by at least two distinct sources. The live index.html is byte-identical to pages/index.html at the pin.

The pinned records and checked data/ingredients.json index contain 2,953 ingredients: 2,611 MAPPED, 260 UNMAPPED, 81 REJECTED and 1 AMBIGUOUS (88% mapped after rounding). The record total and status distribution are unchanged. Ingredient evidence and specific CultureMech recipe links are now rendered in the browser. Browser metadata uses directory placement instead of status for the separate mapped/unmapped file totals. The new causal-graph schema admits sibling-record links, but no ingredient record contains a causal graph at this pin; the associated snapshots and semantic integration remain planned. The live ingredients.json had moved past the pin when this audit was written; data_sha256 is the live copy and data_sha256_at_pin is docs/data/ingredients.json at the pin.

3,115 natural product structures at the pin, matching the landing prose, with ten adopted sources including PathwayMech. The README and page report 3,407 producer claims, 806 supported by evidence addressing the organism, and 2,342 records with cited occurrences. The corpus has 164 records describing biosynthetic pathways. Resolving the pinned causal_graph_refs gives 278 graph-bearing records and 776 individual graphs: 533 inline graphs plus 243 referenced components. Every referenced component matches its owner’s record ID and InChIKey. The vocabulary census retains its existing owner-record globs and does not separately scan these component files. The live index.html is byte-identical to pages/index.html at the pin.

269 data/pathways records at the pin, matching 269 links in its committed browser. They contain 14,260 mechanistic edges across 105 taxa, with 5,868 distinct reference IDs. The corpus contains 20,695 structured source assertions and 863 quoted evidence items. Current complete KGX downloads under pages/downloads match all 269 records; separate SSSOM source mappings remain available in the repository. Export availability does not establish kg-microbe ingestion. The optional curation_history schema retains its explicit TaxonMech CurationEvent reference; 99 YAML records contain 122 inline events, with additional canonical history stored separately. PathwayMech is measured by the common census, subset and statistics pipeline. The live browse.html is byte-identical to pages/browse.html at the pin.

429,293 records and 34 browser source labels in runtime data/facets.json and the YAML corpus (the static landing HTML states 429,291). The source-label fallback manual groups several imported sources; it is not a distinct evidence source. The retained corpus map covers 344,797 current records, with 84,496 outside that snapshot. The protein map covers 68,657 Swiss-Prot proteins and the sequence map covers 12,705; these derived views are distinct from the complete record browser. The committed cross-Mech snapshot scans thirteen sibling repositories and retains 16,082 recognized UniProt mentions from six of them, including structured fields and prose references. These discovery records are separate from the measured data/traits corpus. Its protein inventory distinguishes 939 proteins with qualified examples, 667 with legacy examples only and 996 discovery-only proteins; those qualifications are not whole-record REVIEWED statuses, and sibling assertions alone do not qualify examples. The served file is built in CI rather than committed, so there is no copy at the pin to compare.

625,960 species-level and infraspecific data/taxa records at the pin, equal to the landing tile. Higher taxa are carried in lineage fields rather than counted as standalone records. The canonical taxon tree and README statistics are unchanged; browser rendering and filters have advanced. The live index.html is byte-identical to pages/index.html at the pin.
